subject: An English-Hebrew code-switching fine-tune of Parakeet
preheader: On-device dictation that writes the Hebrew words English speakers in Israel use.
paragraphs: I'm Daniel, an English speaker in Jerusalem. I fine-tuned Parakeet TDT 0.6B v2 so that English dictation writes the Hebrew words English speakers here mix in, such as kupat holim, in one consistent romanization.
It runs on-device through the free Hebrish app. The models, data and results are open: [hebrish.app](https://hebrish.app).
Would it be useful to you? I'd be glad to hear what you think.
